t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes are always in teh same pair, each gnome pair brings you either to a light forest or a dark forest, you need to get the most amount of mushrooms but the number of mushrooms in each forest changes. There is a point multiplier.

vb_textbox.text: I will keep this shortThe gnomes will always appear in the same coloured pairs, one of those colours will lead you to a darker green forest and the other the light green. The coloured gnome will always lead you to that forest, but the amount of mushrooms in each forest changes. I noticed that changes (that is, the better forest will supply 4 or more mushrooms, and the worse one 3 or less will change occasionally) typically happened on the 1x multiplier, with the 5x multiplier being the coloured forest of the one before that. Once a change occurs, it will tend to be that coloured forest for the next few rounds until it changes more often than not at 1x, however whenever you notice a change go to the opposite coloured forest. Apologies if that was nonsense, but it will make more sense once you're in.
